text:
emma: Heads-up — batch payout 2026-05-04 (batch_id: BATCH-5421) from Acme Corp failed auto-allocation. Bank posted with truncated remittance memo, nothing tied to PO. Can someone pick this up?

raj: On it. Do we have the original ACH/MT instruction that left the memo intact? Need to confirm whether truncation happened pre-send or at correspondent bank.

maria: I pulled the outgoing file from the payments queue: the `remittance` field includes `PO:98765; TAX:VAT21` — looks fine on our side. Posting snippet: 
```
batch_id,account,to_bank,amount,currency,remittance
BATCH-5421,ACCT-01,BOFAUS3N,12500.00,EUR,"PO:98765; TAX:VAT21; INV:2026-0442"
```

oleg: Thanks @maria. I checked the incoming confirmation from the beneficiary bank — their `remit_info` column shows `PO:98765; TAX:VA` (truncated) and their system couldn't map to our invoice because PO was truncated to 9 chars. Looks like a field-length truncation at intermediary.

emma: Ugh. That explains why the ledger didn’t auto-apply. Is this a one-off or is the bank truncating all long memos?

oleg: Appears only for messages routed via CORP_SWIFT_GATEWAY-2 for EUR rails. I pulled two more recent batches and one had the same pattern when `remittance` exceeded 28 chars.

raj: We need MT103/trace from correspondent to confirm. Can payments-bot request the MT103 from BOFA? Also need exact `field:59` / `field:70` contents. @payments-bot kick off a support ticket.

payments-bot: request_sent: Ticket #PAY-9122 opened with BankOps. Requesting full MT103 and raw message. ETA 24-48h.

maria: For immediate remediation, can we run a manual allocation by matching on amount + beneficiary acct + partial PO? Risky but might save caller downtime — customer on support line is pushing to get invoice cleared for tax.

oleg: Manual allocation plan: match on amount and acct, then attach evidence file and set allocation_reason = "manual-bank-trace". I'll prepare a patch to allow fuzzy PO match (first 8 chars) for the next 48h. Need sign-off from finance.

emma: Approve provisional fuzzy-match for this batch only. Add audit flag and require second approver. Also escalate to Treasury to request fixed field length SLAs with the correspondent.

payments-bot: manual_allocation_started: BATCH-5421, alloc_user=oleg, second_approver=maria, audit_tag=PAY-9122-manual.

raj: BankOps responded (via ticket): they provided a partial MT103 extract — `:70:/PO 98765 INV 2026-0442 VAT21`. They confirm truncation occurred at the correspondent because of a legacy SWIFT gateway limit (28 chars in :70:). They propose two options: 1) shorten remittance on send side, 2) use structured remittance (ISO20022) with dedicated PO field.

maria: Given this customer's volume we should implement ISO20022 structured remittance as medium-term fix. Short-term: apply a truncation-safe hash in our outgoing file and include full details in an attached metadata file that our receivable ops can ingest. Example prefix we can add: `PO=98765;H=3f2b1` (where H is a 6 char checksum).

oleg: Implemented manual allocation for BATCH-5421 and attached MT103 to ledger. Reconciled invoice 98765, tax applied correctly after manual adjustment. Left TODO for infra to add ISO20022 opt-in.

emma: Great work. Leave the ticket open until Treasury confirms SLA with correspondent and until engineering has a rollout plan for structured remittance. Closing loop — customer notified and invoice marked paid. :white_check_mark:

maria: I uploaded the MT103 PDF to the ticket and notified the customer success rep to close the Zendesk case.

payments-bot: ticket_update: #PAY-9122 status=awaiting-corr-action, attached_files=[mt103-BATCH-5421.pdf], manual_alloc=true.

oleg: Action items: 1) Eng infra to add 28-char guardrail + structured remittance rollout plan (owner: eng-payments) 2) Treasury to negotiate field-length SLA with correspondent (owner: emma) 3) Finance to sign-off on temporary fuzzy-match policy (owner: maria).

emma: Thanks team. Reopen if anything else pops up.
